sources.claim: Generates M overloads for M default parameters; each successively omits the last default-taking parameter and parameters to its right, preserving the parameters to its left.
Adds a static method for a function; properties receive additional static getter/setter methods.
Exposes property as a field without generated getters/setters.

Companion @JvmStatic generates both enclosing static method and companion instance method; @JvmOverloads omits each default parameter and those to its right; Java defaults are otherwise only exposed through full signature.
